anotoki.language.label.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: the small heading above the languages on offer, and the accessible name of that group. The languages themselves are shown in their own names and are not strings. No placeholders.

anotoki.language.button.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: the accessible name of its button, which shows only the current language's code ("SK"). {name}: that language in its own name ("Slovenčina"), shown as it is. {code}: the code the button shows - keep it in, for somebody who speaks to the computer names the button by what it shows (WCAG 2.5.3, Label in Name). Placeholders: {name}, {code}.

anotoki.language.notLoaded.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: said when the words of the language chosen there could not be fetched; the page stays in the language it was in. No placeholders.
anotoki.language.notLoaded.en: The language could not be loaded. Try again.
anotoki.language.notLoaded.sk: Jazyk sa nepodarilo načítať. Skús to znova.

anotoki.language.notSaved.description: The anotoki library's language switcher: said to somebody signed in when the language chosen there could not be saved to their anotoki account (the IAM out of reach, the sign-in ended); the page stays in it until it is loaded again. Not said for a language the account does not offer - that one is the site's own choice. No placeholders.
anotoki.language.notSaved.en: The language could not be saved to your anotoki account - it holds for this visit only.
anotoki.language.notSaved.sk: Jazyk sa nepodarilo uložiť do tvojho anotoki účtu - platí len počas tejto návštevy.

anotoki.siteStatus.updatingTitle.description: The anotoki library's status page, while a database update waits (shown to everybody but the site's ADMIN): its heading. No placeholders.

anotoki.siteStatus.updatingText.description: The anotoki library's status page, while a database update waits: the sentence under its heading. The page asks again by itself and reloads once the site is back. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.updatingText.en: It will be back in a few minutes. This page reloads by itself.
anotoki.siteStatus.updatingText.sk: O pár minút bude späť. Táto stránka sa obnoví sama.

anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableTitle.description: The anotoki library's status page, while the site cannot reach its database: its heading. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableTitle.en: The site is not available right now

anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableText.description: The anotoki library's status page, while the site cannot reach its database: the sentence under its heading. The page asks again by itself. It speaks to the reader: a site that addresses its readers formally words it its own way. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableText.en: Please try again in a few minutes. This page reloads by itself.
anotoki.siteStatus.unavailableText.sk: Skús to znova o pár minút. Táto stránka sa obnoví sama.

anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpTitle.description: The anotoki library's status page, on a site that was never set up: its heading. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpTitle.en: This site is not set up yet
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpTitle.sk: Táto stránka ešte nie je nastavená

anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpText.description: The anotoki library's status page, on a site that was never set up: the sentence under its heading, above the button to the setup page. No placeholders.
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpText.en: Its setup page connects it to its database and to the anotoki sign-in.
anotoki.siteStatus.notSetUpText.sk: Stránka nastavenia ju prepojí s databázou a s prihlasovaním anotoki.

anotoki.siteStatus.openSetup.description: The anotoki library's status page, on a site that was never set up: the button that opens its setup page. No placeholders.

anotoki.siteStatus.tryAgain.description: The anotoki library's status page: the button that asks the site again at once, instead of waiting for the page to ask by itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.siteStatus.signIn.description: The anotoki library's status page, while a database update waits and nobody is signed in: the quiet link to sign in, which is how the site's ADMIN gets to the update. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.close.description: The anotoki library's dialogs and side panels: the accessible name (and tooltip) of the button with an X that closes one. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.dismiss.description: The anotoki library's notifications (the short messages in a corner of the page): the accessible name (and tooltip) of the button with an X that puts one away. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.notifications.description: The anotoki library's notifications: the name screen readers give the corner of the page where they appear. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.cancel.description: The anotoki library's "Are you sure?" question: the button that answers no, where the page does not word it its own way. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.confirm.description: The anotoki library's "Are you sure?" question: the button that answers yes, where the page does not word it its own way. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.retry.description: The anotoki library's box for something that could not be loaded: the button that asks again, where the page does not word it its own way. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.optional.description: The anotoki library's form fields: the small word after the label of a field that may stay empty, in small letters. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.loading.description: The anotoki library's spinner: what a screen reader hears while something loads (and what it says beside it, where it says anything). No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.showPassword.description: The anotoki library's password field: the accessible name (and tooltip) of the eye button while the password is hidden. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.hidePassword.description: The anotoki library's password field: the accessible name (and tooltip) of the eye button while the password is shown. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copy.description: The anotoki library's copy button: its words, where the page gives it none of its own. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copied.description: The anotoki library's copy button: its words for a moment after it copied. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copyToClipboard.description: The anotoki library's copy button that shows only an icon: its accessible name and tooltip. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copiedToClipboard.description: The anotoki library's copy button: what a screen reader is told once the text is copied. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.copyFailed.description: The anotoki library's copy button: said when the browser would not copy (no permission, a page not served over https), so the reader copies the text by hand. No placeholders.
anotoki.ui.copyFailed.en: Copying did not work. Select the text and copy it yourself.
anotoki.ui.copyFailed.sk: Kopírovanie nefungovalo. Označ text a skopíruj ho ručne.

anotoki.ui.qrCode.description: The anotoki library's QR code: the accessible name of the picture, where the page gives it none of its own. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.or.description: The anotoki library: the small word on the line between two ways of doing the same thing (one way of signing in, or the other), in small letters. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.pages.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: the accessible name of that row of buttons. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.previous.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: the button to the page before. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.next.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: the button to the page after. No placeholders.

anotoki.ui.range.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: which of its items are shown. {first}: the first one shown, {last}: the last one shown, {total}: how many there are. Placeholders: {first}, {last}, {total}.

anotoki.ui.pageOf.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: where in the list the reader is. {page}: the page shown, {pages}: how many pages there are. Placeholders: {page}, {pages}.

anotoki.ui.nothingToShow.description: The anotoki library's page numbers under a long list: said instead of the items shown while the list is empty. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.skipToContent.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the link that shows on the first press of Tab and takes the keyboard past the bar to the page itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.sections.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the name screen readers give the row of the site's own links (its sections), where the site gives it none of its own. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.phoneMenu.description: The anotoki library's top bar on a narrow screen: the accessible name of the button that opens the menu holding the site's links. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.menuButton.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the accessible name of the round button with the person's initials, which opens their menu. {name}: the person's name, as their anotoki account has it. Placeholders: {name}.

anotoki.topbar.menu.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the name screen readers give the person's menu itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.roleAdmin.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the person's role, under their name at the top of their menu, when they are the site's administrator. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.roleEditor.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the person's role, under their name at the top of their menu, when they are one of the site's editors. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.account.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the item of the person's menu that opens their account at anotoki (their profile, password and sign-ins) in a new tab. "anotoki" is the name of the accounts, never translated. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.admin.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the item of the person's menu that opens the site's admin panel. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.signIn.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the button that signs in, while nobody is signed in. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.signOut.description: The anotoki library's top bar: the last item of the person's menu, which signs them out. No placeholders.

anotoki.topbar.saving.description: The anotoki library's top bar: said in place of "Sign in" or "Sign out" while what was changed last is still being saved, and the item waits for it. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.label.description: The anotoki library's theme switch (light, dark, as the device is set): its small heading, and the accessible name of the group. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.light.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the light look. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.dark.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the dark look. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.auto.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the look that follows the device's own setting. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.autoHint.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: the tooltip that says what the automatic look is. No placeholders.

anotoki.theme.notSaved.description: The anotoki library's theme switch: said to somebody signed in when the look chosen there could not be saved to their anotoki account; the page shows the account's own again. No placeholders.
anotoki.theme.notSaved.en: The theme could not be saved to your anotoki account.
anotoki.theme.notSaved.sk: Vzhľad sa nepodarilo uložiť do tvojho anotoki účtu.

anotoki.signIn.signingIn.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page (the site's address the anotoki account sends the reader back to): what it says for the moment the sign-in is being finished, before the page the reader was on comes back. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.failedTitle.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: the heading over why a sign-in came back without one, could not start, or cannot be offered right now - the reason under it, then the buttons to try again and to go back. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.notCompleted.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when the reader came back from their anotoki account without signing in - they went back from its page, or the account was turned away. Under it, the buttons to try again and to go back. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.expired.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when a sign-in came back that did not start on this page or took too long (an old tab, a link opened twice). No placeholders.
anotoki.signIn.expired.en: The sign-in took too long or did not start on this page. Try again.
anotoki.signIn.expired.sk: Prihlásenie trvalo príliš dlho alebo sa nezačalo na tejto stránke. Skús to znova.

anotoki.signIn.storageUnavailable.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when the browser does not let the site keep anything (its storage blocked or switched off), so a sign-in cannot even start. No placeholders.
anotoki.signIn.storageUnavailable.en: This browser does not let the site remember a sign-in. Allow the site's storage, then try again.
anotoki.signIn.storageUnavailable.sk: Tento prehliadač nedovolí stránke zapamätať si prihlásenie. Povoľ jej ukladanie údajov a skús to znova.

anotoki.signIn.unavailable.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when the site cannot offer signing in right now (its server did not say where the anotoki accounts are, or they do not know the site). Under it, only the button to try again. No placeholders.
anotoki.signIn.unavailable.en: Signing in is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
anotoki.signIn.unavailable.sk: Prihlásenie teraz nie je dostupné. Skús to znova o pár minút.

anotoki.signIn.failed.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: said when a sign-in came back with any other failure. {code}: the failure's short code ("server_error"), shown as it is, for whoever helps the reader. Placeholders: {code}.

anotoki.signIn.retry.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: the button under what went wrong that starts the sign-in again. No placeholders.

anotoki.signIn.back.description: The anotoki library's sign-in page: the button under what went wrong that goes back to the page the sign-in started on, without signing in. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.title.description: The anotoki library's feedback form (the form a site's visitors send it a message with): its title, and the name of the dialog a site opens it in. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.lead.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the sentence under its title. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.lead.en: Something broken, an idea, a question? Tell us - every message is read.
anotoki.feedback.lead.sk: Niečo nefunguje, máš nápad alebo otázku? Napíš nám - čítame každú správu.

anotoki.feedback.kind.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the question over the kinds of message (something does not work, an idea, something else). No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.kindBug.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the kind of message about something on the site that does not work. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.kindIdea.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the kind of message with an idea for the site. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.kindOther.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the kind of message that is neither (a question, a thank-you). No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.section.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the list of the site's places the message can be about. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.sectionNone.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the first choice of the list of the site's places, for a message about none of them. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.subject.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the message's subject. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.message.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the message itself. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.messageHint.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the hint under the message. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.messageHint.en: What happened and what should have happened - or what would be better.
anotoki.feedback.messageHint.sk: Čo sa stalo a čo sa malo stať - alebo čo by bolo lepšie.

anotoki.feedback.email.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of the sender's e-mail address, which they may leave empty. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.emailHint.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the hint under the e-mail address. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.emailHint.en: Only if you would like an answer. It is used for nothing else.
anotoki.feedback.emailHint.sk: Len ak chceš odpoveď. Na nič iné ju nepoužijeme.

anotoki.feedback.anonymous.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the box a signed-in sender ticks to send the message without their name. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.anonymousHint.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the hint under the box that sends a message without the sender's name. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.anonymousHint.en: Neither your account nor your address goes with it.
anotoki.feedback.anonymousHint.sk: Nepôjde s ňou ani tvoj účet, ani tvoja adresa.

anotoki.feedback.send.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button that sends the message. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.sending.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button while the message is on its way. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.thanks.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the title said once the message came. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.thanksText.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the sentence under the thanks. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.thanksText.en: Your message is on its way to us.
anotoki.feedback.thanksText.sk: Tvoja správa je na ceste k nám.

anotoki.feedback.another.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the button under the thanks that opens an empty form again. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.messageRequired.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside the message when it was sent empty. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.subjectRequired.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside the subject when a message of a kind that needs one was sent without it. No placeholders.

anotoki.feedback.tooLong.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside a field that is longer than the site takes. {max}: how many characters it takes. Placeholders: {max}.

anotoki.feedback.emailInvalid.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said beside an e-mail address that is not one. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.emailInvalid.en: That does not look like an e-mail address.

anotoki.feedback.tooManyHour.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when one sender sent many messages within an hour; the message is not taken. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyHour.en: Thank you - but that is a lot of messages in a short while. Try again in an hour.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyHour.sk: Ďakujeme - no to je veľa správ za krátky čas. Skús to znova o hodinu.

anotoki.feedback.tooManyDay.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when one sender, or everybody, sent many messages today; the message is not taken. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyDay.en: Thank you - but there have been a lot of messages today. Try again tomorrow.
anotoki.feedback.tooManyDay.sk: Ďakujeme - no dnes prišlo veľa správ. Skús to znova zajtra.

anotoki.feedback.unavailable.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when the site cannot take messages right now (its database waits for an update). No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.unavailable.en: Messages cannot be sent right now. Try again in a few minutes.
anotoki.feedback.unavailable.sk: Správy teraz nemôžeš poslať. Skús to znova o pár minút.

anotoki.feedback.signInRequired.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said on a site that takes messages from signed-in people alone, to somebody who is not. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.signInRequired.en: Sign in to send a message.

anotoki.feedback.failed.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when a message could not be sent for any other reason; what was written stays in the form. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.failed.en: The message could not be sent. Try again - what you wrote is still here.
anotoki.feedback.failed.sk: Správu sa nepodarilo poslať. Skús to znova - tvoj text tu stále je.

anotoki.feedback.network.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: said when the site could not be reached at all. No placeholders.
anotoki.feedback.network.en: The site could not be reached. Check the connection, then try again.
anotoki.feedback.network.sk: Stránka nie je dostupná. Skontroluj pripojenie a skús to znova.

anotoki.feedback.honeypot.description: The anotoki library's feedback form: the label of a field people never see or reach (robots fill it in, and their messages are dropped) - for a screen reader that finds it anyway. No placeholders.
